changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE orders ( id NUMBER(19,0) GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY ,user_id NUMBER(19,0) NOT NULL ,order_number VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL ,amount NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL ,status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'NEW' NOT NULL ,created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT LOCALTIMESTAMP NOT NULL ,CONSTRAINT uk_orders_order_number UNIQUE (order_number) ,CONSTRAINT ck_orders_status CHECK (status IN ('NEW', 'PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED')) ,CONSTRAINT fk_orders_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) );
